{{Vanilla|Splash}}
'''Splash texts''' are the yellow messages that bounce beside the logo on the title screen. The [[Matcha Flavoured]] resource pack replaces the whole vanilla list with 51 of its own, so none of the vanilla splashes appear while the pack is enabled.<ref name="file">{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/texts/splashes.txt}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.7-alpha|Added a custom title screen, panorama and the first splash texts ("Some are cringe, ill fix it later").<ref>{{Cite changelog|0.7-alpha|quote=A proper title screen, panorama, and some splashes (Some are cringe, ill fix it later)}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.03|Removed one splash "because I think some people might not find it as funny as I did", and added others.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.03|quote=Added some splashes that I think are pretty funny}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.10|Added seven splashes, including the two about [[sacred texts]], and removed "some splashes that aren't hitting anymore".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=Removed some splashes that aren't hitting anymore}}</ref>}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* Several splashes credit people: musicians ("Music by Ciren!", "Music by Vee!", "Music by DeBlezyBestie!", "Music by Hyperryft!"; see [[Credits]] and [[Music]]) and fellow YouTubers.
* "Ft. The Divine Comedy!" and "Ft. Paradise Lost!" refer to two of the [[sacred texts]], and "Ft. Apollo" to the god behind the [[Prayer of Apollo]].
